title: Saving an unchanged job no longer adds rows to the jobs system tables
body: Saving a job without changing its settings no longer adds rows to `system.lakeflow.jobs` or `system.lakeflow.job_tasks`, and `change_time` stays at the last change. This applies to saves from the UI, the Jobs API, and Declarative Automation Bundles. See [Jobs table schema](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/jobs#jobs).
